interface.longDescription: trackly finds openings as they appear using your preferences and job metadata. You decide what to pursue. trackly Apply fills approved applications for your review, and you always submit manually. It does not make hiring decisions or activate an employer's Submit control.
defaultPrompt: Find the newest product roles that match my preferences.
Show the newest remote roles from companies trackly monitors.
Use trackly Apply to fill my next approved application, then stop before Submit.
